nvitk.cluster.remote_submit
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.cluster.remote_submit

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Optional SSH helper to run an emitted SGE bash script on a login node.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.cluster.remote_submit.run_sge_script_ssh
   nvitk.cluster.remote_submit.run_sge_script_ssh_capture


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: run_sge_script_ssh(host: str, user: str, password: str, script_path: pathlib.Path | str, *, local_script_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, port: int = 22, timeout: float | None = None) -> bool

   Execute ``bash <script>`` on *host* via Paramiko. Returns True on exit 0.


.. py:function:: run_sge_script_ssh_capture(host: str, user: str, password: str, script_path: pathlib.Path | str, *, local_script_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, port: int = 22, connect_timeout: float | None = None) -> tuple[int, str, str]

   Execute ``bash <script>`` on the cluster; return ``(exit_code, stdout, stderr)``.

   *connect_timeout* applies only to the SSH handshake. The remote ``bash`` run
   blocks until the script exits; there is no read timeout while the script runs
   (large cohort submissions may take many minutes).
